testResults.name: bicep-build
testResults.result: The resource-group market-lake composition compiled without diagnostics

testResults.name: bicep-lint
testResults.result: The market-lake composition linted without diagnostics

testResults.name: dev-parameter-file
testResults.result: The westus2 dev parameter file compiled; it contains no secret values and visibly selects the dev names, image digest sentinel, disabled external API ingress, and explicit Key Vault public-network choice. The Container Apps module is the single Log Analytics owner and applies seven-day retention.

testResults.name: compiled-composition-assertions
testResults.command: PowerShell static assertions over az bicep build --stdout compiled ARM JSON
testResults.result: Compiled ARM assertions found six resource-group modules for storage, identities, Key Vault, access, Container Apps, and cost controls; deterministic resource-group-derived naming; runtime identity resource and client ID wired to both workloads; runtime storage and Key Vault role-assignment inputs wired from module outputs; digest-addressed shared image input; explicit Key Vault network selection; one seven-day Log Analytics workspace; 40 USD and 70 USD monthly budget controls; and the configured non-secret runtime guardrails

testResults.name: secret-free-and-deployment-boundary
testResults.result: The composition creates no Key Vault secrets and accepts no provider credentials, tokens, account keys, passwords, or registry credentials. The dev file contains only a fake digest-shaped image sentinel and REPLACE_WITH_BUDGET_CONTACT_EMAIL sentinel, both documented as mandatory user input before Azure operations

testResults.name: azure-resource-group-validation
testResults.command: az deployment group validate --resource-group fca-rg-westus2 --parameters infra/parameters/dev.local.bicepparam
testResults.result: Azure validation succeeded against the existing westus2 dev resource group. The local parameter file is git-ignored and no parameter values are retained in this evidence record

testResults.name: azure-dev-what-if
testResults.command: az deployment group what-if --resource-group fca-rg-westus2 --parameters infra/parameters/dev.local.bicepparam --result-format ResourceIdOnly
testResults.result: What-if succeeded with creates only and no delete or modify operations. The duplicate Log Analytics resource warning is resolved. Four runtime role assignments are unsupported on the first preview because their IDs depend on the runtime managed identity principal ID created by the same deployment; they are exactly the intended Blob, Queue, Table, and Key Vault secret assignments

parametersRequiringUserInputBeforeAzure.requiredValue: The actual digest-addressed reference emitted by the GitHub GHCR publication workflow
A valid Cost Management notification email address
The first day of the intended monthly budget period when deployment occurs

limitations: Azure resource-group validation and what-if were run against the existing empty dev resource group; no deployment, Cost Management mutation, or data-plane call was run.
The Container Apps module owns the single Log Analytics workspace and applies the configured seven-day retention; cost-controls reports the same guardrail without redeclaring the resource.

The dev Key Vault public endpoint choice is enabled explicitly because no private endpoint or private DNS module is in scope. Key Vault remains Entra-only and RBAC-authorized; set allowPublicNetworkAccess to false only after private connectivity is composed.

The what-if used an authenticated Azure caller, the existing westus2 resource group, and a git-ignored local parameter file. No tracked Bicep parameter contains a secret; provider/API credentials remain deferred to authorized Key Vault seeding.
